defects.description: Grammatically incorrect title; literal translation of 'Network Servers' without proper adjective agreement.
Lack of parallel structure in the list; 'корневых' is an adjective while 'домен верхнего уровня' is a noun phrase, making the sentence grammatically disjointed.
defects.quote: авторитетных корневых, домен верхнего уровня (TLD) и других серверов

defects.description: Incorrect translation of the technical term 'Origin' in the context of DNS zone files; 'Начало' is too generic and does not reflect the technical meaning.
Literal translation (calque) of the impersonal pronoun 'One'; 'Один хочет' is unnatural in Russian technical documentation.
Redundant and grammatically incorrect phrasing resulting from the literal insertion of the glossary term 'Обратная запись DNS' into the phrase 'reverse DNS entries'.
